q: What is the objective of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana?
options: To provide finance for building wealth of farmers
To provide part time non-agricultural jobs to farmers
To supplement agriculture, modernize processing and decrease Agri waste
To provide long term assistance to farmers to consolidate land assets
key_text: To supplement agriculture, modernize processing and decrease Agri waste
explanation: PM Kisan SAMPADA aims to supplement agriculture, modernise processing and decrease agri-waste through food-processing infrastructure; it is not a wealth, job or land-consolidation scheme.

q: Co-operative dairy system has been very successful in following state
explanation: Co-operative dairying has been most successful in Gujarat – the Anand pattern (Amul, GCMMF) that Operation Flood copied; Tamil Nadu, Odisha and Karnataka have smaller federations.

notes.text: - **Co-operative dairying is most successful in Gujarat** (Anand, Amul, GCMMF) – the pioneer of India's cooperative dairy movement.
